title: add-rag-agent-templates-and-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Menon
description: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts plus docs site updates. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-ready examples that demonstrate RAG + agent patterns, tool calling, and structured output using Redwood APIs so teams can onboard faster and validate cost/latency tradeoffs. This PR includes: 1) three reusable RAG agent templates (qa-agent, summarization-agent, multi-step-action-agent) with configuration examples for caching, chunking, and model fallbacks; 2) two tool-calling quickstarts (calendar-integration and ticket-creator) showing tool schema, function/structured responses, and recommended retry/backoff; 3) docs site pages with narrative quickstarts, diagrams, and copyable snippets; 4) updated redwood-examples repo with runnable playbooks and test harness. Checklist: - [x] Templates implemented and tested locally - [x] Quickstarts integrated with examples CI smoke tests - [x] Docs pages written and staged on docs site - [x] Reviewed by platform and DX - [x] Small perf run to validate KV cache warmup doesn't regress tail latency Testing notes: quickstarts include a minimal docker-compose and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the examples against a sandbox API key. Related: follows work in ENG-4821 to standardize agent templates and builds on earlier RAG quickstart PRs. No breaking API changes.
